popCulture.title: Ilus (son of Tros)
popCulture.description: Son of Tros who followed a cow to the site of Ilium — founder of the city that Troy’s later kings inherit, father of Laomedon.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca (foundation of Ilium)
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus recounts Ilus’ oracle-cow and the founding of Ilium — the handbook version of how Tros’ son planted the citadel that Priam would lose.
